title: Client information
summary: Covers client relationships, the financial information given to a client and the documents handed over at the end of an installation.

sections.heading: Customer requirements
paragraphs: Good relationships with the customer are essential. Communicate clearly, efficiently, courteously and honestly.
bullets: Communicate clearly, efficiently, courteously and honestly.

sections.heading: Financial information
paragraphs: The client needs financial information about the work.

sections.heading: Handover information
paragraphs: At handover the client is given a set of documents about the completed installation.

flashcards.front: How should you communicate with a customer?

flashcards.back: No. The customer is not 'always right', though good relationships are essential.

flashcards.front: List the financial information given to a client.
flashcards.back: Estimates, quotations, payment schedules, invoice statements and cancellation rights.

flashcards.front: Which certificates are part of handover information for the installation itself?
flashcards.back: Electrical Installation Certificate or Minor Works Certificate.

flashcards.front: Which drawings are handed over to the client?
Name the handover documents relating to equipment.
Name the handover certificates for safety systems.
flashcards.back: Emergency lighting test certification and fire alarm system certification.

flashcards.front: Which handover document relates to energy?
Which handover documents mention design and benchmarking?
flashcards.back: Benchmarking documents and the design philosophy statement.

quiz.q: Which of these is a customer-requirements point for an electrician?
options: Communicate clearly, efficiently, courteously and honestly
quiz.why: Communicate clearly, efficiently, courteously and honestly; the customer is not 'always right'.

quiz.q: Which of these is financial information given to a client?
quiz.why: Payment schedules are listed under financial information.

quiz.q: Which of these is handover information rather than financial information?
quiz.why: As fitted drawings are listed under handover information; the others are financial.

quiz.q: Which certificate is handed over for a small addition to an installation?
quiz.why: The handover list includes the Electrical Installation Certificate/Minor Works Certificate.

quiz.q: Which of these is financial information?
quiz.why: Quotations are one of the listed items of financial information.

quiz.q: Which document is part of the handover information relating to emergency systems?
quiz.why: Emergency lighting test certification is listed under handover information.

quiz.q: Which of these is NOT in the list of financial information?
quiz.why: Warranty details are handover information; the others are financial information.

quiz.q: Which of these is listed as handover information?
quiz.why: Energy performance certification is handover information; the others are financial.
